questions.cardText:
[Physics] What happens if you strike a magnet with a piece of copper?
A. The magnet loses some of its magnetism
B. The magnet becomes stronger
C. The magnet attracts more non-magnetic metals
Answer: A. Striking a magnet, regardless of whether it is with a piece of copper, can cause the tiny magnetic areas inside it, called domains, to get misaligned, which makes the magnet weaker or even lose its magnetic power completely.
questions.en: What happens to a magnet's strength when you strike it hard, for example with a piece of copper, and jar its magnetic domains out of alignment?
questions.de: Was passiert mit der Stärke eines Magneten, wenn man kräftig auf ihn schlägt, etwa mit einem Stück Kupfer, und so seine magnetischen Domänen durcheinanderbringt?
questions.answerEn: It loses some of its magnetism
questions.answerDe: Er verliert einen Teil seines Magnetismus

timeline.labelEn: Pierre Weiss proposes magnetic domain theory
timeline.labelDe: Pierre Weiss entwickelt die Theorie der magnetischen Domänen (Weiss-Bezirke)

questions.notes: Wikipedia (Magnetic domain): heating or hammering a magnet frees pinned domain walls and demagnetizes it. Hard permanent magnets resist this.

questions.cardText:
[Zoology] How many oceans contain sharks?
A. Three B. Four C. All of them
Answer: C. Sharks are highly adaptable and they can occupy a wide range of marine environments.
questions.en: How many of the world's five oceans are home to sharks?
questions.de: In wie vielen der fünf Weltmeere leben Haie?

timeline.labelEn: Devonian period: the first shark-like chondrichthyans appear
timeline.labelDe: Devon: die ersten haiähnlichen Knorpelfische treten auf

questions.notes: Wikipedia: 'Sharks are found in all seas' — including the Arctic (Greenland shark) and the Southern Ocean (e.g. Southern sleeper shark).
